inlines.v: LUST'Y, adjective [from lust.] 1. Stout; vigorous; robust; healthful; able of body. this is the correct sense of the word, comprehending full health and strength; as a lusty youth. But it is now used in the sense of, 2. Bulky; large; of great size. This sense does not always include that of vigor. 3. Handsome; pleasant; saucy. obsolete 4. Copious; plentiful; as a lusty draught. 5. Pregnant; a colloquial use.
